directives: Consolidate duplicate ticker posts into one per day unless a major new catalyst emerges
Avoid publishing more than two consecutive posts from the same category (e.g., bubble_risk, earnings)
Only cite support/resistance levels with at least 3 touches; otherwise label them as tentative
Ensure every post has a non-empty caption with a clear headline and key number
Split captions over 2000 characters into a thread or shorten to avoid clipping
